title: WATKINS v TAUTOKO MAI SEXUAL HARM SUPPORT SERVICES TRUST
text:
IN THE EMPLOYMENT RELATIONS AUTHORITY
WELLINGTON
I TE RATONGA AHUMANA TAIMAHI
TE WHANGANUI-A-TARA ROHE
[2026] NZERA 519
3361263
BETWEEN DEBBIE WATKINS
Applicant
AND TAUTOKO MAI SEXUAL
HARM SUPPORT SERVICES
TRUST
Respondent
Member of Authority: Claire English
Representatives: Mark Beech, counsel for the Applicant
Stephen Corlett, counsel for the Respondent
Investigation Meeting: On the Papers
Determination: 3 August 2026
CONSENT DETERMINATION OF THE AUTHORITY
[1] On 9 June 2026, the Authority issued a determination in this matter, dismissing
the applicant’s claims.
[2] In that determination, the parties were encouraged to resolve any issue of costs
between them, and the Authority made reference to its usual practice of applying the
daily tariff to determine costs.
[3] The parties have conferred and have resolved this matter on their own terms. At
their request those terms are now, by consent and by this determination, also the orders
of the Authority in this matter.

[4] Accordingly, orders are made as follows:
a. Ms Watkins will pay to Tautoko Mai Sexual Harm Support Services
Trust the sum of $5,373, being the equivalent of the Authority’s daily
tariff applicable to a hearing lasting one-and-a-quarter days.
[5] In the event that there remain any outstanding issues as to the method or timing
of payment, these may be remitted to the Authority as needed.
Claire English
Member of the Employment Relations Authority
parties: WATKINS v TAUTOKO MAI SEXUAL HARM SUPPORT SERVICES TRUST
